description: This file defines a singleton object 'RepositoryProvider' which acts as a factory/provider for different repository instances related to user profile, connection, and transfer history. It handles the creation of these repositories, primarily using Room database access objects, with fallback logic for the profile repository.

methods.name: profileRepository
methods.description: Provides a ProfileRepository instance, using Room database if available, otherwise falling back to an in-memory version.

methods.name: connectionRepository
methods.description: Provides a ConnectionRepository backed by Room.

methods.name: transferHistoryRepository
methods.description: Provides a TransferHistoryRepository backed by Room.
